name: magnesium hydroxide + silodrate
purpose: Purpose Magnesium Aluminosilicate Antacid Magnesium Hydroxide Antacid
uses: Uses relieves these symptoms: ■ heartburn ■ sour stomach ■ acid indigestion
otcwarn: Do not use this product if you are taking a prescription antibiotic drug containing any form of tetracycline. Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug. Antacids may interact with certain prescription drugs.
